title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29
lineage: Transfer: Cassette > Tascam 122 MK3 > Korg MR2000S > DFF @5.6 MHz > Audiogate > wav 24/96. Lineage: wav 24/96 > iZotope RX8 Advanced
taper: This is Mark Cohen’s tape (Judy Lee’s brother) who worked for Electra records. It was given to Mark by Hail Milgraham, who was a colleague at Electra.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1966 show, praised for its historic vibe and clear audio.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers unanimously highlight the vibrant energy of this mid‑60s performance and commend the recording as an important piece of audio history. While no specific songs or technical quirks are mentioned, the soundboard source is described as clear and enjoyable, making it a worthwhile listen for fans of early Dead shows.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (average 4.7 stars) and note both great performance energy and good audio quality, though details are sparse.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as clear and historic with no reported flaws or noise issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners comment on the overall high energy and that the band was "on point" throughout the evening, suggesting a consistently strong set.
